notes.title: MugenCards is available for purchase again
notes.notes: Yesterday there was an issue where MugenCards was shown as being no longer available for purchase. After contacting Valve support about it, they promptly fixed the issue, and MugenCards is available for purchase once more. We apologize for any inconvenience caused during that time.

notes.title: MugenCards - v1.3.2 Update
notes.notes: Minor SDK fix. Please see v1.3.1 Update notes for other changes.

notes.title: MugenCards - v1.3.1 Update
notes.notes:
MugenCards will soon be back on sale, and in order to prepare for that a new update has been uploaded. This new update brings the game to feature parity with the mobile release.

Some changes since the last update include:
- You must reach a level before being able to select it in level select.
- Decafesoft copyright added to title screen.
- Fullscreen toggle (Alt + Enter) no longer results in an improperly scaled screen in windowed mode.
- Streak is now recorded as part of high score, and can be viewed in the high score menu.
- Added screen smoothing setting in screen settings.
- High Score animation has been tweaked.

notes.title: New company setup, sale option will be temporarily removed
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I am informing you all that MugenCards will be temporarily removed from sale. As for the reason why, I have recently setup a new LLC and am transferring the rights to MugenCards from "me as a human" to my new company, thus I technically no longer have the rights to it on this account. 

Once my company's Steamworks account is setup, MugenCards will be available on Steam once again. I estimate that it could take 3-6 months primarily due to the requirements to setup a company bank account where I live. I apologize deeply for the inconvenience.

In the mean time, please look forward to the mobile release of MugenCards, as well as a new update to the Steam version not too long after!

notes.title: MugenCards - v1.2 Update
notes.notes:
- Level and streak is now shown at the top-right corner of the screen during gameplay. (The level determines the speed of the blue card(s) and how many blue cards there are.)
- The level can now be selected before when first starting a game.
- Minor changes made to the title screen logo.
- Fixed an audio glitch where the item button would get progressively louder and louder if the player restarts after losing a round while not having any items.
- Version indicator has been added to the title screen.
- Small font has been changed for readability.
- View High Score has been moved to Options menu.
- Background movement speed has been slowed down, and is now animated.
- Level is no longer determined by coin amount, and instead now determined by streak. For every streak of 10 the level will rise until you reach level 10.
- Music has now been added.
- Other minor changes to improve the overall presentation.ad now determined by streak. For every streak of 10 the level will rise until you reach level 10.
